name: tui-reply-workflow
description: Contextual Messages-pane reply composition through the real TUI and board storage
given: Temporary real board with a seeded topic, thread, and message
TUI launched in tmux with an explicit active identity
when: Press n outside Messages and before opening a thread
Open a thread in Messages and press n
Press Enter on an empty reply
Force a real storage write failure and retry after restoring storage
Rapidly press Enter twice while switching to another topic
then: n is inert without an opened Messages thread
Help advertises [n] reply only when available
Empty Enter keeps composition open
Successful reply persists exactly once with the active identity and refreshes visible message and thread state
Failed persistence leaves exact board contents unchanged, displays an error, and retains one draft that can be retried exactly once
Pending loads hide prior thread and message rows so the rapid second Enter cannot select or write to the prior topic

name: tui-refresh-isolation
description: Focused TUI refreshes preserve or invalidate dependent state according to pane scope using the real terminal and SQLite board
given: Temporary real SQLite board with an Announcements topic, Welcome thread, and persisted terminal-doctor reply
when: Open the Welcome thread and focus Topics
Insert Aardvark Dispatch through the real CLI so it sorts before Announcements, then press r
Focus Threads with Tab and press r
Reopen the Welcome thread in Messages
Verify reply help plus current thread, reply content, and identity before pressing r followed immediately by n, text, and Enter
then: Topics refresh moves the cursor to keep the original Announcements UUID/name selected while Aardvark Dispatch appears earlier and the opened thread/messages remain coherent
Both topic UUID prefixes resolve to their exact expected names and real thread storage is unchanged
Threads refresh restores the Welcome thread list and clears its dependent Messages content and reply help without changing storage
Messages refresh restores reply help, the Welcome thread, and the terminal-doctor reply
Rapid reply input during Messages refresh does not compose, display an error, or change real thread storage
validates: Topic refresh identity across sorted insertion
